items.html: Behold, at the beginning of the emanation ZA was in the aspect of only six extremities, and the female was the tenth aspect, in the secret of a small point included of ten, and there was no complete Partzuf in her. And behold, this point, about which we say "and it illuminates the pupil of the eye," as explained at length in the blessing "Hamaplil" (Who causes the bands of sleep to fall), etc. — and see there well, for there this entire discourse is explained. And this point had the strength to stand with him face to face, as mentioned there. And the reason for the matter is well explained in Discourse 5 of the Tefillin: why they are worn by day and not by night. And it is that this point is now the aspect of her Keter. And enough in this.
